description: Control (not in the paper): the Appendix D.2 quantum GCN with only the top-3 Ising ground-state correlation eigenvectors non-zero (columns 4-20 zeroed). Every graph's correlation matrix has rank 3 or 4, so every graph then has exactly 3 non-zero columns: this removes the rank-count signal while keeping the model, input width, dataset, split and training protocol identical.
